question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among the security groups whose ratio is greater than 75% of (ports that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation) compared to (ports that are DOWN and bound to that security group), what is the maximum number of distinct IP allocation subnets (SUBNET_ID) observed on any single admin-up port associated with that security group? Return the security group ID and this maximum distinct-subnet count. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH sg_port_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sgb.security_group_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ipallocations ia WHERE ia.port_id = p.id) THEN p.id END) AS admin_up_with_ip_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' THEN p.id END) AS down_port_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON p.id = sgb.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
  GROUP BY sgb.security_group_id
),
qualifying_sgs AS (
  SELECT security_group_id
  FROM sg_port_counts
  WHERE admin_up_with_ip_count > 0.75 * down_port_count
),
port_subnet_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sgb.security_group_id,
    p.id AS port_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON p.id = sgb.port_id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND sgb.security_group_id IN (SELECT security_group_id FROM qualifying_sgs)
  GROUP BY sgb.security_group_id, p.id
)
SELECT
  psc.security_group_id,
  MAX(psc.distinct_subnet_count) AS max_distinct_subnets
FROM port_subnet_counts psc
GROUP BY psc.security_group_id
